title: Fighting Heats Up in Colombia
gist: Podcast episode notes only: Colombia's new President Abelardo de la Espriella, in office since August, has launched an offensive against armed groups, which have retaliated with increased violence; the episode covers Venezuela's changed border approach, U.S. regional policy, and drones.

insights.claim: Colombia's new President Abelardo de la Espriella, who took office in August 2026, has launched an offensive against the country's various armed groups.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: A hardline security pivot in Colombia shifts the country's risk profile for investors in energy and mining regions.

insights.claim: Colombian armed groups have retaliated against the government's crackdown with an increase in violence.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Rising violence raises operational and security risk for assets and infrastructure in conflict zones.
insights.quote: Those groups have retaliated with an increase in violence.

insights.claim: Venezuela has changed its approach along the Colombian border, and drones are playing a role in the Colombian conflict.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Border dynamics with Venezuela and drone proliferation are variables to watch for regional stability.
